# wordstats

Counts the words in a piece of text.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

request: Quick one: Add a `top_words(text, n)` function to the wordstats package that returns the n most frequent words as (word, count) pairs, highest count first and ties in alphabetical order. Export it from the package. Commit your change when you are done. Thanks!

assert top_words("", 3) == []
